race.description: Allwood Stud Farm 3YOF Westbred Classic Fnl (G2)
race.comment: SOVEREIGN JEWEL (1) was a beaten favourite when resuming but she didn't miss by much and will be fitter for it. Was very good with a string of wins and placings last campaign, ending the prep with a close second in the Diamond Classic to follow a win here. Should get every chance from this draw. JUSTASMOOTH MIKI (2) is building in fitness and looks close to a win after back-to-back placings. Draws lower than when beaten 2m into third last start. Big chance. A PRECIOUS GEM (4) is a player off a win over this distance the last time she raced here two back. MISS BEJEWELED (11) may need some luck from the back row but is hard to knock after winning both starts this time in.
